scope: For every natural n, the exact source (n+1)-square complex matrix has eigenvalue zero if and only if n>0. Negative lower binomial indices are represented by an explicit i<=j guard.
zero_case: M0=[3], proved nonzero determinant/eigenvalue exclusion; no boundary-only disproof.
positive_case: Odd n uses Lampe proposed nonzero LEFT vector; even positive n uses MTyson proposed nonzero RIGHT vector. Both identities proved for all n via classical finite binomial identities, not finite screens.
prior_review: Bounded primary review found no exact prior settlement; historical priority is not guaranteed. Source vector proposals credited to Lampe and MTyson.
